en.content: Choose the correct stability order of group 13 elements in their + 1 oxidation state :

options.content: Al < Ga < In < Tl
Tl < In < Ga < Al
Al < Ga < Tl < In
Al < Tl < Ga < In

en.explanation:
Due to inert pair effect, stability of +3 oxidation state decreases and that of +1 oxidation state increases for (down the group) group 13 elements.

So, the correct order of stability of group 13 elements in their +1 oxidation state is Al < Ga < In < Tl.

hi.content: + 1 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था में समूह 13 के तत्वों के स्थायित्व के सही क्रम को चुनें :

options.content: Al < Ga < In < Tl
Tl < In < Ga < Al
Al < Ga < Tl < In
Al < Tl < Ga < In

hi.explanation:
निष्क्रिय युग्म प्रभाव के कारण, वर्ग 13 के तत्वों के लिए (वर्ग में नीचे जाने पर) +3 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था की स्थिरता घटती है और +1 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था की स्थिरता बढ़ती है।

अतः, वर्ग 13 के तत्वों की +1 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था में स्थिरता का सही क्रम Al < Ga < In < Tl है।

en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : In 'Lassaigne's Test', when both nitrogen and sulphur are present in an organic compound, sodium thiocyanate is formed.

Statement II : If both nitrogen and sulphur are present in an organic compound, then the excess of sodium used in sodium fusion will decompose the sodium thiocyanate formed to give NaCN and Na2S.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

options.content: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.

en.explanation: Both statement I & statement II are correct

hi.content:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं :

कथन I : लैसें परीक्षण में जब किसी कार्बनिक यौगिक में नाइट्रोजन एवं सल्फर दोनों उपस्थित होते हैं तो सोडियम थायोसायनेट का निर्माण होता है।

कथन II : जब किसी कार्बनिक पदार्थ में नाइट्रोजन एवं सल्फर दोनों उपस्थित रहते हैं तो सोडियम संगलन में उपयोग की गई सोडियम की अधिक मात्रा, उत्पन्न सोडियम थायोसायनेट को अपघटित कर एवं बना देता है।

उपर्युक्त कथनों के संदर्भ में नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सर्वाधिक उचित उत्तर को चुनें :

options.content: कथन I एवं कथन II दोनों सही हैं।

संकुलों पर विचार करने पर :

  1. CoCl₃.4NH₃ : इस संकुल में 3 क्लोराइड आयन हैं, अतः यह वह नहीं है जिसे हम ढूँढ रहे हैं।

  2. NiCl₂.6H₂O : इस संकुल में 2 क्लोराइड आयन हैं, अतः यह एक संभावित विकल्प है।

अतः, जिस संकुल में हमारी रुचि है वह NiCl₂.6H₂O है।

Ni²⁺ की स्थिति में, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास [Ar]3d8 है। अष्टफलकीय संकुल के लिए, लिगैंडों के प्रभाव में d-कक्षक दो समुच्चयों में विपाटित हो जाते हैं: समुच्चय जिसमें d(x²-y²) और d(z²) कक्षक सम्मिलित हैं, और समुच्चय जिसमें d(xy), d(xz) और d(yz) कक्षक सम्मिलित हैं। इलेक्ट्रॉन पहले निम्न ऊर्जा वाले कक्षकों को भरेंगे।

en.content: The number of oxygens present in a nucleotide formed from a base, that is present only in RNA is ___________.
en.explanation:
Uracil is the base present only in RNA; its nucleotide is uridine 5′-monophosphate (uracil + ribose + phosphate).

Uracil contributes 2 oxygens, the two C=O groups at C-2 and C-4.

Ribose contributes 4 oxygens: the ring oxygen, the 2′-OH, the 3′-OH and the 5′-O that links the phosphate.

The phosphate group adds 3 more oxygens (one P=O and two P–OH), the bridging 5′-O having been counted with ribose.

Total number of oxygens .

Hence, the answer is 9.

en.content: The remainder when (2021)2023 is divided by 7 is :
en.explanation:
(2021)2023

= (2016 + 5)2023 [here 2016 is divisible by 7]

= 2023C0 (2016)2023 + .......... + 2023C2022 (2016) (5)2022 + 2023C2023 (5)2023

= 2016 [2023C0 . (2016)2022 + ....... + 2023C2022 . (5)2022] + (5)2023

= 2016 + (5)2023

= 7 288 + (5)2023

= 7K + (5)2023 ...... (1)

Now, (5)2023

= (5)2022 . 5

= (53)674 . 5

= (125)674 . 5

= (126 1)674 . 5

= 5[674C0 (126)674 + ......... 674C673 (126) + 674C674]

= 5 126 [674C0(126)673 + ....... 674C673] + 5

= 5 . 7 . 18 [674C0(126)673 + ....... 674C673] + 5

= 7 + 5

Replacing (5)2023 in equation (1) with 7 + 5, we get,

(2021)2023 = 7K + 7 + 5

= 7(K + ) + 5

Remainer = 5

Given below two statements : One is labelled as Assertion (A) and other is labelled as Reason (R).

Assertion (A) : Non-polar materials do not have any permanent dipole moment.

Reason (R) : When a non-polar material is placed in an electric field, the centre of the positive charge distribution of it's individual atom or molecule coincides with the centre of the negative charge distribution.

In the light of above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below.

options.content: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct.
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct.

en.explanation:
Non-polar bonds do not have any net dipole moment and are generally formed in compound where there is presence of symmetry.

When non polar material placed in electric field, due to redistribution of charges dipole is formed.

So, (R) is incorrect.

en.content: In free space, an electromagnetic wave of 3 GHz frequency strikes over the edge of an object of size , where is the wavelength of the wave in free space. The phenomenon, which happens there will be :

options.content: Reflection
Refraction
Diffraction
Scattering

en.explanation:

en.content: In a vernier callipers, each cm on the main scale is divided into 20 equal parts. If tenth vernier scale division coincides with nineth main scale division. Then the value of vernier constant will be _________ 102 mm.
en.explanation:
1 MSD = cm

10 VSD = 9 MSD

1 VSD = cm = 10 mm = 0.45 mm

Now, 1 MSD = 10 mm = 0.50 mm

LC = (0.50 0.45) mm = 0.05 mm

= 5 102 mm
